note:
v0.29.3 官方网站上线 + 下载入口收敛（网页与 APK 同版）

· 官方网站正式上线（5 页，中英双语）：首页、功能详解、上手方式、下载、联系我们。站点沿用产品同一套视觉语言（石墨底 + 单一信号红），不是另做一个产品。
· 数字全部可溯源：页面上每一个对外数字（137 条主句示范音频 / 409 句可跟读语料 / 54 个场景 / 585 张字卡 / 7 种界面语言 / 30 天路径等）都由脚本从产品源码现算，页面写错当场报错——没有一个是估的。
· 下载入口收敛到一处：应用内「我」页页脚新增常驻官网入口；免费额度用尽时的「装 App · 不限次数」按钮、以及应用内更新提示，全部指向新的下载页。旧地址 /download.html 与 /download 自动跳转到新页，老链接不会失效。
· 下载页的版本号、文件体积、构建号、MD5 全部在打开时实时读取，不再写死在页面里——从此不会出现「页面写着旧版本、点下去下到新包」这类对不上的情况。
· 本次网页与 APK 正式同版发布（App 用户请更新以拿到新的下载入口）。学习进度、连胜、复习计划与今日路径全部保留，无需重新设置。
noteEn:
v0.29.3 Official website + one place to download (web and app ship together)

· The official website is live (5 pages, English and Chinese): home, features in detail, how it works, download, and contact. It reuses the same visual language as the app itself (graphite base, a single signal red) rather than looking like a different product.
· Every number has a source: each figure on the site (137 model-audio lines / 409 lines you can read after / 54 scenes / 585 flashcards / 7 interface languages / 30-day path) is computed by a script straight from the product source, and the build fails if a page disagrees — none of them are estimates.
· One place to download: the footer of the app's Me screen now carries a permanent link to the site, and both the "Install App · Unlimited" button on the free-limit wall and the in-app update prompt now point at the new download page. The old /download.html and /download addresses redirect automatically, so older links keep working.
· The download page reads the version, file size, build number and MD5 live each time it opens instead of hard-coding them — no more cases where the page names one version while the button fetches another.
· Web and app are released together this time (update the app to get the new download entry). Your progress, streak, review schedule and today's path are all preserved; nothing needs setting up again.
